host:fs.readBytes.change: Adds the existing workspace-local fs.read authority to a bounded lossless byte-range transport. Managed files still resolve at the caller's exact semantic working head and scratch files remain context-contained; each response is capped at 1 MiB, carries canonical base64, exact byte continuation coordinates, total size, and a whole-file SHA-256, and grants no write or path-enumeration authority.

host:fs.readText.change: Adds the existing workspace-local fs.read authority to a bounded UTF-8 text-range transport. The receiver retains semantic path admission for managed files and scratch-root containment for disk files, caps each response at 10,000 lines and 1 MiB, returns continuation coordinates plus a content hash, and grants no write or path-enumeration authority.

host:workspace-state.panel.sourceUsage.change: Adds an open workspace-member read of at most 200 aggregate panel source usage rows for launcher ranking. The projection contains only source identity, access count, and last-access time; it exposes no panel contents, owner identity, slot state, or mutation path.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Adds an open code-principal write that records the execution boundary for one exact method call. The receiver derives caller identity from the runtime, requires it to equal the claimed provider participant, and updates only that participant's current claim generation once; it grants no call, result, or cross-participant authority.

host:auth.mintAgentCredential.change: Reuses the existing subagents.create decision for the credential-bearing portion of an external subagent launch. The receiver still requires a live exact agent session and restricts code callers to a session they own. The authenticated agent retains that relationship for ownership and audit and deliberately acts on behalf of the owning user for open and gated workspace operations; critical effects remain on the fresh-confirmation path.

host:auth.revokeAgentCredential.change: Makes exact agent credential retirement non-prompting lifecycle cleanup. The receiver admits only host or code principals, restricts code callers to the owner of the live bound session, and only revokes the selected credential and its derived ephemeral bearer.

host:panelRuntime.awaitAttempt.change: Adds an open, read-only wait for one opaque panel attempt already reachable by the caller. It observes lifecycle settlement without creating, activating, navigating, or granting control of a panel.

host:panelRuntime.awaitSlot.change: Renames the existing open slot-lifecycle wait while preserving its caller-reachable exact slot scope and read-only supervision semantics.

host:panelRuntime.getAttempt.change: Adds an open, read-only resolution of one opaque attempt reference. The receiver returns bounded lifecycle identity and state without panel mutation or authority acquisition.

host:credentials.resolveCredential.change: Opens only the mediation entrypoint and removes its redundant generic credential.use dispatcher prompt. The handler still matches the concrete credential and requires the existing exact credential, caller, use, audience, workspace, and grant-scope authorization before returning any credential summary or material.

host:remoteCred.getCurrent.change: Opens the secret-free remote connection status projection to its existing authenticated principals. App callers remain restricted by the handler to authorized workspace chrome carrying panel-hosting; no pairing material, refresh token, credential value, or connection mutation is exposed.

host:runtime.recoverExecution.change: Opens only the transport for exact execution recovery and admits code principals so the trusted Shell app can carry the user's notification action without a self-referential grant. The receiver requires live interactive panel-hosting chrome, binds the entity and expected execution digest, and rejects stale or ordinary installed-app calls.

host:shellApproval.listPending.change: Opens approval-queue rehydration while selecting a prepared approvals.read leaf for non-chrome code. Trusted panel-hosting presenters and host principals select no leaf, so the surface that renders authority requests never depends on the grant it must present.

host:shellApproval.getWorkspaceCreationR.change: Opens startup-review state discovery while selecting a prepared approvals.read leaf for non-chrome code. Trusted presenters can always render the launch decision; other installed presenters retain ordinary approvals.read enforcement.

host:shellApproval.resolve.change: Opens the approval decision transport while selecting a prepared approvals.decide leaf for non-chrome code. Trusted presenters answer only exact live queue entries and no longer require authority to grant that same authority.

host:shellApproval.resolveMissionReview.change: Opens exact mission-review resolution for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared approvals.decide leaf for non-chrome code and the receiver's authenticated-human requirement.

host:shellApproval.resolveInstallReview.change: Opens exact install-review resolution for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared approvals.decide leaf for non-chrome code, selected-row validation, admission recording, and clearance minting in the receiver.

host:shellApproval.resolveBootstrap.change: Opens convergent bootstrap-review resolution for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared approvals.decide leaf for non-chrome code and exact pending-review validation.

host:shellApproval.submitClientConfig.change: Opens the protected-input transport for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared protected-input.submit leaf for non-chrome code and exact pending client-config validation.

host:shellApproval.submitCredentialInput.change: Opens the protected-input transport for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared protected-input.submit leaf for non-chrome code and exact pending credential-input validation.

host:shellApproval.submitSecretInput.change: Opens the protected-input transport for trusted presenters while retaining a prepared protected-input.submit leaf for non-chrome code and exact pending secret-input validation.

host:view.getPresentation.change: Adds an open, read-only lookup of one exact panel's Electron-local presentation projection. The service handler additionally requires the trusted panel-hosting app capability; it exposes no cross-panel mutation or server lifecycle authority.

host:view.getLocalPresentation.change: Adds an open, read-only lookup of one exact panel slot's revisioned Electron-local lifecycle snapshot. The handler requires trusted panel-hosting chrome and returns bounded loading, contention, ready, or failure facts without acquiring a lease, creating a view, changing focus, or exposing foreign panel state.

host:view.getPresentations.change: Adds an open, read-only batch over at most 2,000 exact panel identifiers. The receiver deduplicates the request, returns only existing Electron-local presentation projections, and retains the panel-hosting app requirement; it grants no panel mutation or runtime lifecycle authority.

host:view.ensurePanelLoaded.change: Adds an open, host-local materialization operation for one exact panel. The service handler requires the trusted panel-hosting app capability and creates the native view without changing layout focus, emitting navigation intent, waiting for visible-slot readiness, or granting cross-panel or server lifecycle authority.

host:view.setFocusedPanelId.change: Adds an open, host-local write of the shell's exact focused panel id. The service handler requires the trusted panel-hosting app capability and records focus without acquiring a panel lease, loading a view, emitting navigation intent, or waiting for readiness.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.page.change: Adds an open, read-only keyset page over one exact panel sibling group. The query is capped at 200 rows, returns only tree-list metadata, and performs no runtime or workspace mutation.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.rootsForC.change: Adds an open, read-only keyset page over roots owned by the server-verified caller subject, or the ownerless workspace band for subjectless infrastructure. The request is capped at 200 rows, accepts no owner identity, returns only tree-list metadata, and leaves the existing cross-owner root discovery and explicit owner query path unchanged.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.rootGroup.change: Adds an open, read-only keyset census of owner groups containing open roots. The query is capped at 200 rows and exposes only owner identity plus root count.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.path.change: Adds an open, read-only root-to-slot ancestry lookup for one open panel. The receiver bounds traversal and returns only tree-list metadata.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.detail.change: Adds an open, read-only lookup of one panel's current slot, history entry, and active entity. It performs no lifecycle or navigation mutation.

host:workspace-state.panelTree.search.change: Adds an open, read-only keyset title search capped at 200 hits with bounded ancestor breadcrumbs. It exposes panel-list metadata and performs no mutation.

host:vcs.finalizeExternalDelta.change: Exposes finalization of one caller-reachable external delta only after the semantic engine proves every effective change is accounted for. The operation releases that delta's dedicated review roots and cannot mutate source content or finalize a foreign or incomplete review.

host:vcs.supersedeExternalDelta.change: Exposes retirement of one caller-reachable external delta so userland can abandon or replace a review it owns. Context and delta identity are receiver-validated; the operation grants no source mutation, merge, or foreign lifecycle authority.

host:runtime.listContexts.change: Adds an open read of context identifiers optionally narrowed by a caller-supplied prefix. It exposes no context contents or mutation authority and lets userland discover its own durable operation journals without host-owned lifecycle state.

host:vcs.registerExternalDelta.change: Adds the existing context-write semantic operation to the ordinary VCS surface so userland can register an exact old-to-new external repository delta for compare and merge. Context ownership, causal references, immutable source coordinates, and repository identity remain receiver-validated; lifecycle retirement and finalization remain internal to merge review.

host:hubControl.routeWorkspace.change: Narrows exact workspace route discovery from write sensitivity to read sensitivity. The method returns only the selected child's reach and performs no registration or lifecycle mutation.

direct:packages/builtin/src/eval-engine/.change: Adds the typed host-only write used to append one already receiver-bound authority lifecycle event to an exact eval run. It cannot choose another owner, execute code, or grant authority.
Adds a host-only bounded cursor read of durable events for an exact EvalDO run. It performs no execution, mutation, or authority acquisition.

Adds a host-only bounded read of immutable execution roots already retained by one EvalDO so the mandatory retention provider can fail closed. It exposes no eval source, result, credential, or mutation path.
Adds a host-only write of one validated immutable execution artifact reference joined to its exact eval run. It cannot fabricate an artifact, widen executable authority, or delete retention.

direct:packages/builtin/src/workspace-st.change: Adds a host-only bounded read of exact execution identities held by active workspace entities for the mandatory retention provider. It exposes no entity payload and performs no lifecycle mutation.

direct:workspace/workers/workspace-sourc.change: Adds an open read-only causal ancestry check between two exact semantic state references. The receiver traverses bounded semantic history and performs no source mutation or filesystem projection.

Adds the host-only acknowledgement that resumes one exact compare or merge after the host returns the content hashes named by the engine. The receiver binds the operation, input digest, causal ingress, and complete hash set; it cannot select different content, mutate another context, or bypass ordinary VCS authorization.

host:attachedHosts.attachClient.change: Adds a hidden read of one live caller-owned attached route's exact run, host, generation, ceiling, and expiry so the runtime can construct ordinary child service clients. The receiver rejects foreign, expired, lost, and wrong-generation routes.

host:attachedHosts.bootstrapConfirm.change: Confirms the exact mutually signed bootstrap transcript before revoking the ordinary pairing credential. Receiver verification binds both hosts, the development run, generation, authority ceiling, expiry, and ephemeral route keys.

host:attachedHosts.bootstrapExchange.change: Exchanges one ordinary device bootstrap for an ephemeral signed route only after receiver validation of the parent, child generation, development run, expiry, and authority ceiling. It returns no admin credential or durable route secret.

host:attachedHosts.close.change: Adds host-only effect reduction for one exact attached session. It closes pending challenges and revokes route state without invoking child services or widening authority.

host:attachedHosts.invoke.change: Adds the host transport entry for one exact signed child invocation. The receiver validates session, generation, expiry, nonce, invocation snapshot, prepared operation, and route ceiling before dispatching the child's ordinary service schema.

host:attachedHosts.invokeAttached.change: Adds the hidden runtime transport behind hosts.attach(...).services. The parent verifies route ownership and signs the exact request; the child then applies its normal schema, relationships, authority ceiling, and acquisition path. No development-specific service bypass is introduced.

host:attachedHosts.listApprovalAudit.change: Adds a hidden read-only page of terminal approval evidence for one live caller-owned route. It returns only signed-request coordinates, canonical invocation and presentation digests, decision, and timestamps from existing durable protocol state; arguments, signatures, keys, credentials, and foreign sessions are excluded.

host:attachedHosts.presentApproval.change: Adds the host-only parent presentation of one verified signed child challenge. The acquisition request is derived from the canonical invocation snapshot and prepared operation, and the signed terminal decision cannot authorize a different request.

host:build.gc.change: Narrows the public method to a zero-argument read-only retention report. Quarantine and sweep are no longer advertised no-op modes and remain available only through the private two-collector epoch coordinator after source-closure preflight and publication interlock checks.

host:eval.events.change: Adds the bounded durable cursor catch-up page for one caller-owned eval run. Live delivery remains on watched events; this read performs no execution, cancellation, reset, or authority acquisition.

host:evalEventIngress.publish.change: Adds a host-only internal publication path for a persisted EvalDO event. The receiver validates the nonce-bound run and re-derives owner and initiating caller before emitting to watched transports; it accepts no caller-supplied audience.

host:evalExecutionRoots.retain.change: Adds host-only typed lifecycle bookkeeping that retains the exact validated execution artifact for the originating eval run. It creates no executable admission, changes no workspace or user state, and cannot widen or delete retention.

host:runtime.faultAbortAgentVessel.change: Adds a hidden code-only fault seam admitted only for the exact attested system-test runner and blessed conduit. It aborts one exact agent-vessel facet while preserving durable state so replay can be proven, and cannot target arbitrary Durable Objects or production callers.

host:browserPermissions.snapshot.change: Replaces an unusable host-only read with a verified-user read of that same user's exact-origin browser grants in the current workspace environment. Code and anonymous principals remain excluded.

host:browserPermissions.request.change: Moves site permission decisions under the verified environment owner's authority. The exact environment, browser-session epoch, and origin are receiver-derived or validated, and the interactive approval remains mandatory when no matching user grant exists.

host:browserPermissions.revoke.change: Allows a verified user to revoke only that user's exact-origin browser grants in the current workspace environment. Code and anonymous principals remain excluded.

host:runtime.reserveEntity.change: Generalizes two-phase reservation to every code-backed runtime kind while binding replay to the original runtime parent or a trusted host. The receiver preserves kind, source, class, context, durable owner, and lifecycle provenance and creates no active execution before activation.

host:runtime.activateReservedEntity.change: Allows only the reservation owner or trusted host recovery to activate a preparing code-backed identity. The receiver validates kind, source, class, and context; a retry of an already-active identity returns its committed execution without re-preparing mutable caller-supplied ref, environment, or state.

direct:packages/builtin/src/workspace-st.change: Generalizes the WorkspaceDO reservation write from panels to the enumerated buildable entity kinds. The host supplies the already validated immutable identity fields, and the receiver atomically creates or returns the exact reserved entity without executing code or widening caller authority.

host:eval.start.change: Replaces the split blocking and asynchronous public eval entry points with one gated owner-scoped acceptance method. The caller must choose the run id before transport; the receiver derives owner, context, channel binding, and execution admission from verified host state, rejects semantic replay drift, and preserves the existing EvalDO terminal push.

host:eval.get.change: Replaces the former asynchronous status method with the sole read-only recovery backstop for the caller-owned run id. The receiver derives the exact owner-scoped EvalDO from verified caller or live owner-session binding and returns only its bounded durable status, progress, and terminal result.

host:build.inspectExecution.change: Adds an open, read-only explanation of one immutable execution digest. It returns only the artifact reference, authoritative owners, and reconstructibility diagnostics already held by retention, and cannot publish, acquire, or delete an artifact.

direct:packages/builtin/src/eval-engine/.change: Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority that creates or refreshes the exact EvalDO incarnation's bounded idle residency lease. The receiver validates the lease identity and duration, and no user or code principal may invoke it directly.
Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority that atomically claims the single held-request slot for an already-active exact kernel lease. It cannot create, widen, or extend a lease.

Adds a host-only, gated code-execution authority whose request remains held only for the exact attached lease and settles on expiry, release, or replacement. It exposes no scope data and cannot outlive the receiver-owned lease deadline.

host:eval.dispose.change: Adds explicit release for an EvalDO whose immutable first activation declared it finite. The receiver derives the exact object from the verified owner and subkey, rejects persistent scopes, erases the finite object's durable records and loaded runtime, and retires it through the normal sealed lifecycle and cleanup reaper. Closing this owned finite resource is open and cannot address another caller's eval state.

host:durableWork.inspect.change: Adds an open, read-only bounded inspection of host durable-work counters and phase timings. It exposes no work payloads, transcript content, credentials, or mutation authority.

host:vcs.listDirectory.change: Adds an open, read-only immediate-child directory projection over the caller's existing semantic VCS read authority. Work is bounded by returned visible entries and does not enumerate descendant file content.

host:vcs.readMemory.change: Adds an open, read-only projection over the caller's existing context-scoped semantic VCS authority. It accepts a canonical managed path, exact returned-bytes hash, and bounded UTF-16 range; returns only bounded blame-backed episodes and typed roots; and owns no facts, claims, mutation, or traversal state.

host:permissions.safetyStatus.change: Adds the permission inventory's bounded read of workspace and per-agent authority locks; the ordinary permissions.read capability and workspace membership checks remain in force.

host:permissions.setWorkspaceAuthorityLo.change: Adds the critical control that durably blocks protected agent authority workspace-wide before interrupting live agent transports. Releasing the barrier uses the same reviewed critical capability.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds a host-only lifecycle operation that enumerates the exact agent vessel's subscribed channels and interrupts their active transports while flushing deferred work; no user, code, or entity principal can invoke it directly.

Restores the reviewed open read used by child-agent launch verification and agent settings UI. It returns only effective model routing, effort, approval level, and response policy for the exact addressed agent; it exposes no credential, prompt content, transcript, or mutation path.

direct:workspace/workers/workspace-sourc.change: Adds an open, read-only exact-coordinate projection over existing trajectory, semantic command, effect-intent, and receipt authorities; every collection is bounded and reports truncation, and the method performs no mutation.

Adds host-only adoption of one exact workspace publication queue generation. A new activation releases only leases held by the previous host worker and grants no access to publication payloads or workspace content.
Adds bounded, generation-fenced claims over committed channel-publication outbox rows. Claims expose only exact channel and stored-envelope coordinates required by the durable delivery driver.
Adds a bounded host read of publication queue readiness and its next recovery time without exposing message payloads, channel history, or workspace source state.
Records bounded retry state only for the exact publication item, worker identity, and lease generation; stale hosts cannot alter a newer claim or discard delivery.
Deletes a publication outbox row only after the exact worker and lease generation report a complete stored-envelope broadcast; missing, partial, duplicate, and stale settlements fail closed.

host:contextIntegrity.explain.change: Adds a read-only agent-bound explanation of a lineage coordinate already present in the caller's own session. The receiver derives session identity, verifies aggregate content addressing, and returns bounded opaque-cursor pages.

host:app.openShellSurface.change: Adds open navigation to an enumerated first-party shell management surface in the current client; it neither opens an external system nor changes managed state, and the receiver rejects unknown targets.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds a host-only, open runtime-intrinsic wake hint after an authority acquisition settles. Durable effect outbox state remains the continuation and ordinary alarms recover a lost hint.
Adds a host-only lifecycle operation that attaches an existing exact agent entity to a channel; the channel independently authenticates the subscribing Durable Object identity.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Adds host-only atomic initialization of an immutable exact-participant channel boundary; user and code callers cannot create, replace, or widen the locked membership policy.

direct:packages/builtin/src/workspace-st.change: Adds the explicit host scheduler generation boundary. It atomically fences prior scheduler claims and installs one exact active worker identity; elapsed time cannot transfer alarm ownership.
Replaces the unfenced due-alarm listing path with a bounded host-only atomic claim carrying an adopted worker identity and claim generation. Claims never expire by elapsed time.
Replaces the prior due-alarm execution feed with a read-only startup census of exact scheduled Durable Object targets. It exposes no alarm payload and grants no claim or execution authority.
Adds the host recovery driver's bounded read of registered durable-work owners; owner-local state remains readiness authority.
Adds idempotent host registration of an exact active Durable Object and its enumerated work queues for recovery scanning.

direct:workspace/packages/runtime/src/wo.change: Exposes only the receiver's fixed supported durable-work queue names to the host activation hook; it reads no semantic or user data.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Installs the exact host durable-work worker generation on one concrete agent vessel and releases only claims owned by the positively superseded generation. No user or code principal is admitted, and elapsed time cannot transfer ownership.

Replaces the former host-only batch-to-inbox relay with one finite transition on the exact addressed vessel. The receiver validates immutable delivery coordinates, its durable channel relationship, and a versioned at-sequence decision context, then retains one outcome by deterministic delivery ID; no user or code principal is admitted.

direct:workspace/packages/runtime/src/wo.change: Adds the common host-only finite delivery entrypoint used after the durable-work host has resolved the exact recipient entity. It forwards one addressed envelope only to that receiver's explicit resident execution session and creates no channel membership, stream, or authority.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Allows code to request cancellation only on the exact child vessel whose durable subagent identity records the verified caller as parent and whose run and task-channel coordinates match. It commits a terminal intent and aborts that run; it cannot cancel a sibling, revive a terminal run, or delete retained state.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Installs the exact host durable-work worker generation on one concrete channel and releases only claims owned by the positively superseded generation. No user or code principal is admitted, and elapsed time cannot transfer ownership.

direct:workspace/packages/agentic-do/src.change: Adds bounded generation-fenced claims over the exact vessel's local inbox and effect projections; no code or user principal is admitted.
Adds a bounded host read of queue readiness and next recovery time without exposing descriptors or transcript content.
Executes only an already generation-fenced effect claim on the exact vessel; live authority is re-evaluated by the narrow executor ports.

Executes only an existing generation-fenced local wake claim on the exact vessel. Wake payloads are closed internal variants; terminal publication remains idempotent and subsequent remote effects retain their own receiver-side authority checks.
Records retry state only when worker identity and worker generation match the exact local claim.
Settles only the exact worker and generation; stale hosts cannot mutate a newer inbox or effect claim.

direct:workspace/workers/pubsub-channel/.change: Adds bounded generation-fenced claims over exact recipient-incarnation batches and channel recovery items.
Adds a bounded host read of channel work readiness and recovery time without exposing message payloads.

Adds an open read of at most 500 exact channel head sequences from the addressed lineage root. The receiver rejects reads from fork nodes, returns no message content, participant data, context state, or subscription identity, and performs no semantic mutation; code callers use it only to reconcile persisted fork unread cursors.

Replaces executable-entity streaming subscription with a finite durable relationship write. The receiver requires the caller to be the asserted participant, the endpoint to be that same Durable Object identity, the entity to be currently active, the locked-channel allowlist to admit it, and revisions to be monotone.

Ends only the verified caller's own durable channel relationship at the exact next revision. It cannot remove another participant or bypass the receiver's pending-delivery derivation before departure.

Lets a verified participant advance only its own read projection for one message. The operation appends no canonical event and creates no agent mailbox work; its optional live emission is a disposable presentation signal to connected external sessions.

Returns only the verified caller participant's own active flag and monotone relationship revision after bringing the disposable projection current. It exposes no roster, message content, or foreign membership.
Moves exact invite-index, call-deadline, and fork recovery items out of alarm activations and executes only an existing generation-fenced claim.
Records bounded retry state only for the exact channel worker and worker generation.
Requires exact worker/generation settlement and a complete gap-free per-row acknowledgement for recipient batches.

direct:packages/builtin/src/development/.change: Adds a read-only typed discovery surface for live reviewed Electron executors owned by the authenticated user. It exposes opaque executor coordinates and platform metadata, not credentials, process handles, or authority.

host:developmentNative.listClientExecuto.change: Projects only the authenticated user's unexpired reviewed executor leases into explicit device-selection coordinates. Selection remains owner-bound and exact; discovery performs no launch or native effect.

host:developmentClientExecutor.register.change: Registers only the verified shell runtime and user as a short-lived current-device Electron executor. The lease is in-memory, machine-bound, and grants no launch authority by itself.

host:developmentClientExecutor.claim.change: Lets only the selected initiating desktop claim one opaque request containing an integrity manifest and ordinary pairing invite. Native server paths, credentials, and foreign-user launches are not exposed.

host:developmentClientExecutor.readArtif.change: Lets only the exact selected desktop read a bounded chunk from its pending immutable artifact manifest. Coordinates are canonical and payload integrity is verified again on the client-owned root.

host:developmentClientExecutor.launched.change: Records the exact selected desktop's owned PID and ownership digest but cannot make a run ready without a distinct ordinarily paired child shell attesting the opaque request nonce.

host:developmentClientExecutor.attest.change: Accepts only the opaque request nonce from a newly paired shell. User, runtime, provider separation, and expected execution identity are all derived from verified caller and live pending state, never from attestation arguments.

host:developmentClientExecutor.fail.change: Lets only the exact selected desktop terminate its pending request with a bounded diagnostic. It creates no process or authority and resolves a concurrent stop as effect reduction.

host:developmentClientExecutor.exited.change: Lets only the original selected desktop report exit of the exact launched PID plus private-root cleanup outcome. The receiver derives whether exit was intentional from host-owned stop state and records unexpected exit durably.

host:developmentClientExecutor.bindIsola.change: Binds the already ordinarily paired management shell to the process-provided exact isolated instance and generation before any client invite is issued. A different device cannot replace it.

host:developmentClientExecutor.consumeAt.change: Lets only the exact bound isolated management shell consume one nonce-bound child runtime receipt. The inbox is short-lived and bounded, and no device credential, artifact path, or self-reported execution digest is returned.

host:shellApproval.resolveInstallReview.change: Adds the typed resolution for a queued install review, replacing the all-or-nothing unit-batch decision. Same gated approvals.decide capability and same trusted-chrome principals as resolve/resolveMissionReview; the server derives the offerable rows itself and rejects any identity or permission the review did not offer, so a client cannot ask for more than it was shown.

host:runtime.recoverExecution.change: Adds gated recovery of one exact active Durable Object execution under the trusted runtime host. Expected execution digests fence stale requests, and the receiver either rematerializes the retained immutable build or performs the explicitly selected replacement strategy without changing durable ownership.

host:shellApproval.getWorkspaceCreationR.change: Adds a read-only projection of whether the host-owned workspace creation review is pending, ready, or resolved. It exposes no approval contents, authority grants, or mutation path and remains under the existing approvals.read capability.
